steps: node …/scripts/ownership-scan.mjs (150 authenticated routes with IDs; 25 flagged by heuristic, all reviewed manually)
title: Positive: object-level access checks hold in code review and live two-account tests
expected: Account B cannot read or change account A's private resources.
actual: All 25 heuristic candidates enforce ownership or membership via helpers or router-level middleware. Live: B gets 403 updating A's business and product, deleting A's product, listing or adding A's payment accounts, and on admin/devops routes; guests get 401; A's product is unchanged. Orders, direct orders and messages were reviewed in code only — live two-party checks follow in Wave 3.
impact: Strong access control; make the two-account script a CI test.
